alt: 竹子一端被撐開後，裂縫順著筆直的竹紋一路延伸，整根竹子很順利地分開。
scene_prompt: 勢如破竹 means unstoppable smooth progress, literally bamboo splitting effortlessly once begun. Contemporary bamboo craft workshop. A skilled ADULT artisan in casual work clothes demonstrates a long bamboo stem held securely on a bench: a simple wooden wedge has started the split at one end, and the clean split runs freely along the straight grain almost the entire length, opening into two smooth slender strips. Clear forward-flowing separation with faint pencil motion strokes, no struggle or obstacles. The artisan calmly guides the bamboo with both hands well away from the wedge, no knives in motion, no children using tools. A few neatly split strips beside the bench reinforce effortless repeated success. No text, arrows, weapons or violence.
